metadata.audit_title: Selection Bias, Hyperparameter Lineage & Preregistration Audit

prototyping_timeline.key_finding: Empirical grid baseline (1.1250 log loss) outperformed Model B (1.1837 log loss) on 2025. The ML model added variance without improving probability calibration on pole sitters.
prototyping_timeline.selection_bias_impact: Disclosed 2025 out-of-sample metrics to engineering team.

models_evaluated: Prior-only empirical baseline (Laplace alpha=1.0 fitted on 2021-2023)
prototyping_timeline.hyperparameter_selection_method: 3-fold cross-validation strictly on 2021-2023 training data selected w=0.20 (geometric) and gamma=0.20 (convex). However, multiple candidate weights were simultaneously evaluated on 2024 and 2025 holdout sets.
prototyping_timeline.selection_bias_impact: Evaluated multiple candidate blends on 2024 and 2025 holdouts. Although w=0.20 was derived from CV, the holdout performance of all alternatives was directly observed.

prototyping_timeline.scope: Independent Hybrid Confirmation & Baseline Fairness Audit
models_evaluated: Geometric Hybrid (w=0.20, Prior alpha=5.0) [NEW POST-HOC ADDITION]
Convex Hybrid (gamma=0.20, Prior alpha=5.0) [NEW POST-HOC ADDITION]
prototyping_timeline.hyperparameter_selection_method: Prompted by observing that Baseline alpha=5.0 outperformed Baseline alpha=1.0 on the 2024 holdout (1.7601 vs 1.8535), new hybrid variants anchoring to Prior alpha=5.0 were formulated and evaluated specifically to test whether the hybrid still dominated the stronger baseline.
prototyping_timeline.selection_bias_impact: Direct post-hoc adaptation: Prior alpha=5.0 was introduced into the hybrid family after inspecting 2024 holdout results. This confirmed robustness, but means Prior alpha=5.0 hybrids were post-hoc rather than pre-specified.

hypothesis_space_audit.primary_family_composition: 5 hybrid variants x 2 holdout seasons (2024, 2025) x 2 baseline references (alpha=1, alpha=5)
hypothesis_space_audit.risk_assessment: While the M=20 family captures all formal primary comparisons presented in Phase 15, an additional ~26 exploratory configurations were evaluated across Phase 14 and Phase 15 sensitivity analyses. Reporting M=20 is appropriate for the primary model portfolio, but selection bias cannot be ruled out when reporting holdout results.

independent_confirmation_rule_ruling.rationale:
1. Both the 2024 historical dataset and 2025 candidate dataset were repeatedly inspected during Phases 13, 14, and 15.
2. The choice of Prior alpha=5.0 for the hybrid was explicitly prompted by observing 2024 holdout results.
3. Multi-weight sensitivity grids were examined across both holdout seasons.
4. In statistical learning theory, once a dataset informs model formulation or hyperparameter choice, it ceases to be an untouched confirmatory test set.
5. Consequently, all reported log loss, Brier score, and accuracy metrics for 2024 and 2025 must be classified as PROMISING EXPLORATORY EVIDENCE, not independent confirmation.
independent_confirmation_rule_ruling.required_action: True independent confirmation requires prospective validation on upcoming untouched 2026 race data.
